searchText: I did some research. I think the open items are to update launchpad to stop allowing empty execution address on their UI, and also nudge wagyu to to use ethstaker-deposit-cli 1.4.0 after it is released. The remaining I found is ethdo, but it gears towards advanced users who understand what they are doing. What's the latest on pq-da? is this still the design? https://ethresear.ch/t/leanda-design-and-benchmark perhaps witout Posseidon? im not sure exactly what eth2-val-tools is used for, but barnabus is on the modifiers ... i ended up making a claude based pr hehe so someone may need to see if theres a better way to do that particular thing There is an EIP currently work in progress for this: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12604 We wrote a blog post about our takeaways from the L1 R&D workshop for the PQ roadmap https://blog.lambdaclass.com/mission-2028-ethereums-cryptography-cant-wait-for-q-day/
